evals.name: basic_short_audio_split
evals.prompt: I have an audio file at '/workspace/test_audio.wav'. Please split it into 3 equal segments and save them in '/workspace/output/'. Also save the full audio there. Return the JSON with the paths and durations.
evals.expected_output: A JSON object containing 'full', 'seg1', 'seg2', 'seg3' paths pointing to /workspace/output/, along with 'duration_seconds' and 'segment_duration' as floats.

evals.name: long_audio_split_verification
evals.prompt: Take the audio file '/workspace/long_podcast.mp3', calculate its total duration, and split it into exactly 3 equal parts by sample index. Save all 4 files (full + 3 segments) to '/workspace/podcast_splits/' and give me the JSON summary.
evals.expected_output: A JSON object with the 4 file paths in '/workspace/podcast_splits/', and duration_seconds roughly matching the original file length, with segment_duration being exactly duration_seconds / 3.0.

evals.name: edge_case_very_short_audio
evals.prompt: Split this very short audio clip '/workspace/short_click.wav' into 3 segments and save them to '/workspace/short_output/'. Return the standard JSON format.
evals.expected_output: A valid JSON object with the 4 paths. Even if the audio is very short, the script should handle the sample slicing without index errors and return valid float durations.
